body: Atlas confirmation: revised sidecar seam is ACCEPTED; no remaining blocking finding in the requested scope. SidecarValue[V] is closed and is required at checked construction, generic JSON decoding, encoding, and materialization; the scalar↔Vector schema confusion is now rejected in both directions, including Vector(1), and cross-typed materializer calls/witness construction are compile-time failures. SidecarLayout is unforgeable checked data; payloadOffset=16, valueCount, byte rowStride, payload length, and bounded rowByteOffset are derived through overflow-checked layout(manifest), and validateBytes returns that same layout only after magic/length/checksum/finiteness validation. The manual LE portable materializer remains separate, so storyatlas4s can own the Scala.js TypedArray/DataView adapter without contaminating NarrativeScene. Header math is internally consistent and the full-fetch/per-tile boundary is now recorded in bd-01M15ABW5GKR97CEWDQT8YCZM3. Proceed to the detached 3-platform candidate court.
